fusion: L2 normalize each layer, concatenate with weights sqrt(0.5), then use original normalized exact nearest-neighbor pipeline
reference_matching: one shared reference patch minimizes combined distance, not independent nearest neighbors per layer
foreground_mask: unchanged official final-layer PCA mask for all variants
parameter_selection: fixed by design, no layer/weight sweep on test labels
calibration: same 20 reserved normal images, only threshold percentile 95
spatial_resolution_claim: Layer fusion does not change the patch grid
